text: This is Composer, an app built on DXOS. A team is working on its architecture guide, in a space they share.
They comment and mention colleagues, and ask an agent for a diagram the same way, right in the document.
Documents, diagrams and sheets are all objects in one graph. A link opens the architecture canvas, and the performance sheet charts its own data.
Projects turn work into tasks. Pick the ones you want, and hand them to an agent.
The agent works through them in the background, and its progress shows up in the project, beside the team's.
The inbox brings mail into the same graph. Messages, people and organizations are linked objects, not rows in someone else's CRM.
From a message, you reach the sender, their company, and everyone you work with there.
The calendar holds the sales review, and its notes link straight to the deal pipeline.
Every view works on the same data, for people and agents alike.
Documents, sheets, maps, games, 3D scenes and meetings. Every plugin is built on the same graph, and you can build your own.
